meta.prompt: Where is my package? Today is Sat 15 Nov. Show a tracking card: the item (Nikon Z fc camera body), carrier DHL Express, tracking number JD014600003SE, estimated delivery Tue 18 Nov and how many days away that is, and the shipment's five stages as a timeline with the current one marked: Label created (Nov 12), Picked up (Nov 13), In transit (Nov 14, current), Out for delivery, Delivered. Say which stage it is at ("Stage 3 of 5"). And a field where I can type delivery instructions and a Save button; once saved the card shows them back to me as saved.
meta.text:
ChatCard "Package tracking" "DHL Express · JD014600003SE" icon:"local_shipping" status:"In transit" tone:accent w:390
  state instructions=""
  state saved=""
  Details rows:[["Item","Nikon Z fc camera body"],["Carrier","DHL Express"],["Tracking number","JD014600003SE"],["Estimated delivery","Tue 18 Nov"],["Days away","3 days"]]
  SectionLabel "Shipment progress" "Stage 3 of 5"
  Steps steps:["Label created · Nov 12","Picked up · Nov 13","In transit · Nov 14 (current)","Out for delivery","Delivered"] current:3
  SectionLabel "Delivery instructions"
  InputField "Instructions" "e.g. Leave with the neighbour at no. 4" =instructions lines:3
  ActionButton "Save" tone:primary enabled:=trim(instructions)!="" -> saved=trim(instructions)
  if saved!=""
    Callout "Saved instructions" "{saved}" tone:good icon:"check_circle"
